summary: OpenAI announces it helped found the Appia Foundation, a Linux Foundation-hosted initiative to develop open standards and assessment criteria for advanced AI systems, and describes its broader participation in AI standards and governance efforts.

practices.reason: The playbook describes what third-party evaluations should disclose, offering a template an engineering team could reference when designing evaluation transparency, but it is a governance document rather than a runnable method.
practices.quote: we set out what frontier assessments increasingly need to disclose: the system tested, its tool access and evaluation harness, the methods used to elicit capabilities, the resources available, and the checks performed to validate the results
